attribution.note: Marcus presents the spending estimate as his own.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the hypothetical framing and approximate retrospective estimate. Numerical approximation does not make this a probabilistic forecast.

contract.note: Cumulative spending through publication is a fair ordinary reading of the monetary estimate. The contract reasonably separates spending from hypothetical waste, preserves approximation, and excludes commitments and double counting.

evidence.note: Microsoft's quarterly disclosure covers broader cloud and AI infrastructure. It does not establish cumulative worldwide LLM spending.
Nvidia's disclosed quarterly Data Center revenue does not isolate LLM chips or establish their cumulative spending share. Adding it to customer purchases could double count.
Reporting on one compensation offer establishes neither payment nor aggregate compensation incurred.
Published before evaluation, this provides relevant methodological cautions. Its 2026 investment forecasts do not measure spending through November 2025.

reviews.rationale: The packet contains no complete, non-overlapping reconstruction of worldwide LLM scaling spending through publication, nor an aggregate Nvidia-chip and compensation share. Partial infrastructure figures and an individual compensation offer neither establish nor contradict the approximate trillion-dollar estimate.
